title: Mtr: Coming Or Going Mtr Train
description: A small, single train resource pack for the Minecraft Transit Railway mod.  This resource pack is designed to be used as an example of how simple adding your own model trains can be.
body:
This pack is designed to be an example of how a basic train model can be created and added into minecraft.  It is supposed to be as simple as possible.  My intention is to create a series of youtube clips to help beginners model their own trains in Blockbench and import them into Minecraft.

This pack should be downloaded for fun and education. This little train would be a fantastic addition to your minecraft world.

It requires [MTR3+NTE]. It may not work with [MTR4]. Required Mods: [Minecraft Transit Railway, Nemo's Transit Expansion]. Optional Mods: [Sodium].
